title: Choose composer actions
responsibility: Chooses the available comment and agent actions and defines visual-plan option counts.

inputs.name: visualCategory.category
inputs.description: The catalog category to classify. Pages, shells and components are visual categories.

inputs.name: composeModes.capabilities
inputs.description: The project capabilities. Comments and agents are the flags used here; planning and approval flags are not checked separately.

inputs.name: composeModes.writable
inputs.description: Whether the shown revision permits writing. Agent actions require this to be true.

outputs.name: designCounts
outputs.description: The selectable design-option counts, all whole numbers from 1 through 10.

outputs.name: visualCategory
outputs.description: True for pages, shells and components; false for other category strings.

outputs.name: composeModes
outputs.description: An ordered list beginning with comment when comments are allowed, followed by plan and change only when agents are allowed and the view is writable. Returns an empty list when none apply.
